classes.label: Race ids named in test_login (10 ids, 8 with model path)
classes.role: player model by race and gender

zones.label: Per-light sky lookup by map and position

looks.label: Additive ribbon trail with age fade
looks.technique: TrailSegment age and max age; RibbonVertex RGBA with alpha fade; additive blend

looks.label: Particle alpha or additive blend
looks.technique: BlendMode Alpha or Additive; additive for fire and sparks

looks.label: Time-of-day sky bands with horizon fog
looks.technique: LightColorBand time slots and packed colours; SkyColors with fog from horizon band; struct holds 16 slots

looks.label: Transparent water depth rule
looks.technique: depth write off, depth test on, so water draws behind terrain

originals.name: Dusk Band Sky
originals.idea: One colour band per time of day sets a zone's mood; fog takes the horizon colour so the seam disappears. Row 16 colour grade.
originals.keep: time-indexed bands; horizon-matched fog; sun disc from the clock
originals.change: our own band count and palette per biome; our own moon; painted clouds

originals.name: Swing Ribbon
originals.idea: An additive ribbon shows the arc of a swing or spell. Rows 10 and 13.
originals.change: jagged edge; tail length set per ability; our colour ramp

originals.name: Behind-Terrain Water Pass
originals.idea: Transparent water writes no depth but still tests depth, so it draws behind terrain. Row 16.
originals.keep: depth write off, depth test on

originals.name: Protected Core HUD Set
originals.idea: A fixed core set of panels that addons cannot remove. Row 14 HUD. Audit-only: not re-read in code.
originals.change: our panel set and layout file format

originals.name: Painted Ground Blend
originals.idea: Four ground layers blended by hand-painted masks so ground reads as ground, not tiles. Audit-only: not re-read in code.
originals.change: our materials; our masks; noise on blend edges
